name: inmu-king
description: A joke mod for Claude Code. Every 淫夢 meme you (or Claude) type lights rainbow letters of T A D O K O R O above the prompt, with a +3 popup and the meme's meaning in English or 繁體中文; eight letters is a burst (a chant, a moving pixel picture, a jingle) and one rank up a chart from #20 to #1. At #1 a pixel crowd dances and Claude ends one reply with やりますねぇ！. A meme collection (梗圖鑑) fills as you go, turn durations become 114514 arithmetic, and your own clips can replace the jingles. Each session plays a game of its own; nothing is saved. /inmu status|burst (demo)|king (demo)|sounds|mute|unmute|reset [all]|band|homo <n>.

sound.title: Sound effects
sound.description: A blip on a hit, a jingle on a burst, a fanfare at the coronation, a sigh on a sin: the mod's own 8-bit sounds, or your clips from the sound folder. Windows plays them through PowerShell, macOS through Claude Code; other platforms stay silent.

sounds_dir.title: Your sound folder
sounds_dir.description: Where your own clips live (wav, mp3, m4a, wma, aac), named for an event (hit, burst, crown, sin) or a meme (iiyo.mp3, やりますねぇ.mp3). Empty: ~/.claude/inmu-king/sounds. /inmu sounds lists what it found.

infect.title: Infect Claude at #1
infect.description: The reply right after a coronation ends with やりますねぇ！ (one extra system-prompt section for that turn; it rebuilds the prompt cache once). Never in -p or SDK sessions. The section asks Claude to skip the line when you asked for an exact output such as JSON only: a request to the model, not a guarantee.

claude_counts.title: Claude's replies count too
claude_counts.description: Memes in Claude's own reply light letters at half points.

band.title: Show the band
band.description: The T A D O K O R O letters above the prompt. Off hides them, and the standing shows in the status line under the prompt instead; /inmu band on|off changes it for the session.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the band, the panel, /inmu's replies and the meaning shown beside each meme (the memes stay Japanese). auto follows Claude Code's own language setting (then the system locale), else English.
